title: HARD MODE
oneLiner: Survive a brutally fast gauntlet of shifting hazards and chase your high score.
mechanics: Move the tiny square through a one-screen maze of sliding hazards.
Touching a hazard ends the run.
Survive to earn points, with bonus points for near misses.
Hazards speed up and patterns become denser over time.

controls.a: Dash briefly in your movement direction

lose: Lose when you collide with a hazard.
scoring: Score points every second, with extra points for near misses.
